description: Single storey rear extension, detached outbuilding to rear, vehicular access and front hardstanding.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:APL-DR-00-00, APL-DR-P1, APL-DR-P1-00-01, APL-DR-P1-00-03, APL-DR-P1-XX-50, APL-DR-P1-XX-, APL-DR-P2, APL-DR-P2-00-11, APL-DR-P2-00-12, APL-DR-P2-XX-70, APL-DR-P2-XX-71, APL-DR-P2-XX-72, APL-DR-P2-XX-73, APL-DR-P2-XX-74, APL-DR-P3-00-10, APL-DR-P3-00-10.1, Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.Reason:  To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the means of enclosure for vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The enclosures shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: To ensure a safe, secure, and accessible environment for all users of the development, including vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists, and to maintain the visual quality and functionality of the site

The proposed outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.
